title: Saamarth City
tagline: Harmony Haven: a luxurious urban oasis
description: A 4-BHK luxury bungalow. Plot 2,480 sq.ft; built-up 4,610 sq.ft.

This design concept embodies a serene and refined aesthetic, where every carefully curated element contributes to an ambiance of understated elegance. By embracing the principles of minimalism, the house strikes a balance between luxury and tranquility — clean, uncluttered lines, and rooms that feel finished without being overworked.

title: Mr. Rao's Residency
description: A 3-BHK apartment. Carpet 1,255 sq.ft; built-up 2,340 sq.ft.
From the warm bedroom to the efficient kitchen, every detail is meant to elevate an urban apartment into a home that matches the client's lifestyle — contemporary, practical, and quietly finished.

title: Mr. Shrivastava's Residency
description: A 2-BHK modular apartment. Carpet 836.5 sq.ft; built-up 1,195 sq.ft.

In the heart of Noida, Sophisticated Living reimagines a compact urban apartment into a seamless blend of style and function. Designed for a modern couple, the home emphasizes clean lines, a smart layout, and understated elegance.

Furniture was chosen with the same care — beds, a dining set with mixed seating, tables, and a sofa arrangement that serve both use and visual calm. Everyday space, treated as an elevated living experience.

title: Mr. Akshay's Residency
description: A 4-BHK modular apartment. Carpet 1,375.5 sq.ft; built-up 1,965 sq.ft.

A timeless blend of sophistication and ease: rooms that open into each other, materials that stay quiet, and a plan that treats luxury as something you live in — not something you look at from the doorway.

title: Corks and Curds
tagline: A curated wine and cheese experience
description: A hybrid retail store. Carpet 1,900 sq.ft; built-up 2,152 sq.ft.

Corks & Curds is a wine and cheese shop planned as one room: tasting, retail, and display sharing a single floor. The layout keeps service clear and the product in view — a small commercial interior with a specific ritual in mind.

title: 3D Visuals
tagline: Photoreal stills for residences and hospitality
description: Includes work such as Ashiana — A Refined Retreat (Ankit Chaudhary, with Gaurang Patel Architects, Gandhinagar, 2023–24), Coral Hostel: Solitaire Mansion (2024), and Jinagar Samaj: Willow Brook luxury bungalow (Gandhinagar, with Gaurang Patel Architects).
These visualisations are photoreal and stylised scenes that hold form, material, and spatial composition. Lighting, texture, and viewpoint are used to carry design intent before anything is built.

title: Construction Drawings
description: Working drawings for Saamarth City, Rao's Residency, and Tanmay Jani's Residency.
These are the scaled sheets used to build: dimensions, materials, and notes required for accurate work on site — the drawings that take a design from screen to structure.

title: Prateek Edifice
description: Interior options for a residence at Prateek Edifice: bed wall, dresser, and wardrobe internals drawn in model before they are built.
The stills hold the palette and joinery so the client can choose a finish, not only a plan.

title: Goklani Residence
tagline: Living, kitchen, bedrooms, and a double-height hall
description: A house visualised room by room: living, kitchen, bedrooms, children's room, temple, balcony, and the double-height volume.
These are the final stills issued from the model — the set used to agree materials and ceiling before drawings go to site.

title: Jawahar Nagar
tagline: Facade and interior options from the model
description: Visualisations for a house at Jawahar Nagar: exterior massing and interior rooms tested in stills before the drawing set.

title: Jinagar Samaj
tagline: Willow Brook: a luxury bungalow, visualised
description: Photoreal stills for Jinagar Samaj, with Gaurang Patel Architects.
Lighting, material, and viewpoint used to hold the design before construction.

title: Coral Hostel
description: A set of room visualisations for Coral Hostel — beds, storage, and light studied as finished interiors.

title: Ashiana — Ankit Chaudhary
tagline: A refined retreat, modelled for the client
description: Visualisations with Gaurang Patel Architects, 2023–24.
Stills of form, material, and spatial composition before anything is built.
